description: Skin Manager for Jellyfin — pick a skin, apply it via Branding custom CSS. Ported to Jellyfin 12.1 and bundled with the JellymountPlus skin.
name: SkinManager
overview: Fork of the community Skin Manager plugin, ported to Jellyfin 12.1, with JellymountPlus bundled as a built-in skin plus the full community skins feed.

versions.changelog: Ported to Jellyfin 12.1 (net10.0). JellymountPlus bundled as a built-in skin; community skins feed mirrored.
